verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only single-run triggering (trigger, triggerAndWait, and a per-handle cancel/retry), concurrency limits, and dashboard filtering of runs. None of these show a documented capability to act on many items at once, such as batch triggering or bulk cancel/replay. Filtering, concurrency and queues are adjacent features, so they earn no credit for bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
